Name: SMK-001 - Portal home page
Objective: Confirm the lab is available for further checks.
Step: Open the confirmed lab URL from Plan setup. Inspect the home page and its main navigation.
Expected Result: The home page and main navigation load; no blocking error prevents interaction.

Name: SMK-002 - Valid learner login
Objective: Confirm a registered learner can access their dashboard.
Step: Start signed out. Enter the prepared LEARNER credentials and select Sign in.
Expected Result: The authenticated dashboard opens and identifies LEARNER; protected learner content is accessible.

Name: SMK-003 - Incorrect password rejected
Objective: Confirm invalid credentials do not grant access.
Step: Start signed out. Enter the LEARNER email and IncorrectPassword!2026, prepared as an incorrect value for this account. Select Sign in.
Expected Result: A visible login error is shown. The session remains unauthenticated and the dashboard is not accessible.

Name: SMK-004 - Open course catalog
Objective: Confirm the learner can reach the catalog.
Step: Sign in as LEARNER. Select the course catalog from the home-page navigation.
Expected Result: The catalog opens and includes the prepared published COURSE.

Name: SMK-005 - Find a known course
Objective: Confirm a known course can be found by keyword.
Step: Sign in as LEARNER. Search the catalog for Testing, which appears in the prepared COURSE title.
Expected Result: Results include the expected COURSE ID and title recorded in Plan setup.

Name: SMK-006 - Open course details
Objective: Confirm essential course details are available.
Step: Sign in as LEARNER. Open the prepared COURSE from the catalog or search results.
Expected Result: The details identify the expected COURSE and show its description and enrollment action.

Name: SMK-007 - Add a course to the enrollment list
Objective: Confirm adding a course changes the selection list.
Step: Sign in as LEARNER with COURSE absent from the enrollment list. Open COURSE, select its add action, then open the enrollment list.
Expected Result: A confirmation is shown and COURSE appears once in the enrollment list.

Name: SMK-008 - Dashboard shows known user data
Objective: Confirm the dashboard reflects the prepared learner data.
Step: Sign in as HISTORY. Open the dashboard and compare its greeting, recent activity and enrolled courses with the recorded fixture values.
Expected Result: The greeting identifies HISTORY; the expected enrollment and mock-payment activity and enrolled-course records are displayed.

Name: SMK-009 - Return home from dashboard
Objective: Confirm the main navigation returns to the portal home page.
Step: Sign in as LEARNER. From the dashboard, select MindBridge in the header.
Expected Result: The portal home page loads and its main navigation is usable.

Name: SMK-010 - Logout removes protected access
Objective: Confirm logout ends access to the learner session.
Step: Sign in as LEARNER and open the dashboard. Select Log out, then request the protected dashboard again. Record the unauthenticated state and access result.
Expected Result: The header shows Log in and Register. The protected dashboard requires authentication and does not expose learner content.
